cases.explain: The negative infinitive without a preposition governs the dative case when addressing someone directly.

cases.sentence: С молодыми ___ говори, как с братьями.
cases.translation: With young men speak as with brothers.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governing a manner or association takes the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Заботься о тех ___, которым действительно некому помочь.
cases.translation: Care for the widows who truly have no one to help them.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) when combined with the partitive meaning uses genitive; here the plural genitive вдов.

cases.sentence: Если же у ___ есть дети или внуки.
cases.translation: If a widow has children or grandchildren.
cases.explain: After the preposition у (with, at) showing possession, the genitive case is required.
The impersonal predicate приятно (pleasing) takes the dative case to indicate the person pleased.

cases.sentence: Требуй исполнение всего вышесказанного, чтобы не было никаких нареканий на ___.
cases.translation: Demand observance of all that has been said, that there be no reproach against the elders.
cases.explain: The preposition на (against) in negative expressions uses the genitive case.

cases.translation: Elders who lead well deserve honor.
cases.explain: The verb вести (to lead/conduct) is transitive and takes the direct object in the accusative case.
The preposition от (from) always requires the genitive case.

reading.ru: С молодыми людьми говори, как с братьями, с пожилыми женщинами, как с матерями, а с молодыми, как с сестрами, со всякою чистотою.
reading.question: How should one address different groups mentioned in this verse?
options: With respect appropriate to family relationships
reading.correct: With respect appropriate to family relationships
reading.explain: The verse specifies speaking to younger men as brothers, older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters — all familial relationships.

reading.ru: Истинная же вдова, то есть та, что осталась одинокой, надеется на Бога и день и ночь обращается к Нему с просьбами и молитвами.
reading.question: What characterizes a true widow according to this passage?
options: She trusts in God and prays constantly
She has no family members left
reading.correct: She trusts in God and prays constantly
reading.explain: The text defines a true widow as one who is desolate and sets her hope on God, continuing in petitions and prayers night and day.

reading.ru: Если же кто не заботится о своих родственниках и прежде всего о своей семье, тот отрекся от веры и хуже неверующего.
reading.question: What does the passage say about someone who does not provide for their family?
options: They have denied the faith and are worse than an unbeliever
They may still be considered faithful
They will be forgiven their transgression
reading.correct: They have denied the faith and are worse than an unbeliever
reading.explain: The text explicitly states that whoever does not care for their own family has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

reading.ru: Молодых вдов в такой список не включай, потому что когда их чувственные желания становятся сильнее их преданности Христу, они хотят опять выйти замуж.
reading.question: Why should younger widows not be enrolled in the official list?
options: Because their sensual desires may overcome their devotion to Christ and they wish to marry again
Because they are too young to pray effectively
Because they prefer to work rather than pray
reading.correct: Because their sensual desires may overcome their devotion to Christ and they wish to marry again
reading.explain: The passage explains that when the sensual desires of younger widows become stronger than their devotion to Christ, they desire to marry again.

reading.ru: Поэтому я советую молодым вдовам лучше выходить замуж, рожать детей, вести домашнее хозяйство и не давать врагу повода к злословию.
reading.question: What does Paul advise younger widows to do?
options: Marry, bear children, manage their households, and give the enemy no opportunity to malign them
Remain single and devote themselves to prayer
reading.correct: Marry, bear children, manage their households, and give the enemy no opportunity to malign them
reading.explain: Paul explicitly advises younger widows to marry, bear children, rule their households, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

reading.ru: Старейшины, хорошо ведущие работу, заслуживают уважения и оплаты за их труд, особенно те, кто проповедует или учит.
reading.question: What compensation do elders who rule well deserve?
options: Honor and payment for their work, especially those who preach or teach
reading.correct: Honor and payment for their work, especially those who preach or teach
reading.explain: The verse states that elders who rule well are worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in word and teaching.
